HubSpot wasn't built for you. It was built for the sales ops team you don't have yet.

So you end up in a Notion table, manually updating deal stages at midnight before a board call. I've been there.

dealpage is a CRM I built for founders running their own sales. The entire pipeline lives on one page. Every action is keyboard-driven and responds in under 100ms — closer to Linear than to Salesforce. No pipelines to configure. No required fields. No admin console.

Two-way Gmail sync is included in the base price, not buried in a higher tier.

One founder migrated 12,000 contacts out of HubSpot in a single afternoon. Forty companies are using it as their primary CRM right now.

It's $19/user/month with a 14-day free trial. Still invite-gated beta, so there's a waitlist — but it moves fast.

If your deal volume just outgrew your Notion table, this is probably the right moment: {APP_URL}
